name: Ben Gurion International
_magVarNote: Degrees EAST. Runway designators are magnetic; ADS-B track is true. trueBearing = magneticBearing + magVar.

runways.note: Shortest and least active runway - mainly cargo and charter traffic.

typicalPattern._note: Fallback only, used when live traffic is too thin to read (quiet hours, or every ADS-B source down). From Moti Kaplan's post: departures are mostly runway 26; the landing runway tracks the time of day because aircraft land into the wind. Live observation always overrides this.

landingByLocalHour.label: night - no published pattern, live data only
